name: executive-readout
title: Executive readout / findings
description: A discovery readout for an executive audience: what we heard, what it means, what to do about it, and what happens next. Reads top to bottom in ten minutes and prints as a defensible record.
notes: exec-summary comes first: an executive who reads one block reads that one.
A finding without an implication is not a finding, so `implication` is required.
methodology sits last. It is the defensibility appendix, not the argument.
